title: Codex starts the first turn without tools from a slow MCP server
symptoms: Tools from an MCP server are missing on the first prompt but appear later
An MCP server launched through npx or docker times out on first start
cause: When building the initial tool catalog, Codex waits only mcp_optional_startup_grace_ms, 1000 ms by default, for optional servers, and each server gets startup_timeout_sec, 10 seconds by default.
fix: Raise startup_timeout_sec for slow servers, mark servers the task depends on as required, or set the grace to 0 to wait for each server's own timeout.
apply:
# ~/.codex/config.toml
mcp_optional_startup_grace_ms = 0
[mcp_servers.docs]
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "docs-mcp"]
startup_timeout_sec = 30
required = true
affected: Codex CLI, IDE extension, and ChatGPT desktop app, as of 2026-10
